info.title: Client_Insight
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

arp_onboarding_info.description: Per Gateway specific ARP latency for the client

end_time.description: Time (in microseconds) since Epoch, when the ARP response from Gateway was received during on-boarding.

start_time.description: Time (in microseconds) since Epoch, when the ARP request to Gateway was received during on-boarding.

l2_info.description: Authentication related attributes for the client.

applied_role_type.description: Type of role applied for the client:  `preauth`:         applied for clients that are yet to be                     authenticated.  `auth`:            applied for clients that have been                     authenticated but have not received any                     specific role or attribute from the                     authentication server.  `reject`:          applied for clients that failed                     authentication.  `critical`:        applied for clients that failed                     authentication due to unreachable.                     authentication servers.  `fallback`:        applied for clients that failed                     to get role type, and no role is derived.  `radius-assigned`: applied for clients that have been                     authenticated and received specific role or                     attribute from the authentication server.  `cached-critical`: applied for clients that failed                     authentication due to unreachable                     authentication servers. This role is                     the previously assigned role for the client                     as provided by the server post authentication.  `critical-voice`:  applied to 'voice' clients that failed                      re-authentication due to server                      unreachability   `ubt-fallback`:    applied for clients on an UBT role that failed                      due to UBT zone unreachability.

authenticating_radius_server.description: RADIUS server that authenticated the client.

failure_reason.description: Client authentication failure reasons. Applicable when the status is  'auth_failed'. 'server-reject':       authentication server rejected client request. 'server-timeout':      no response from the authentication server. 'supplicant-timeout':  dot1x client timed out. 'no-server':                  no authentication servers configured 'attribute-processing-error': error processing attributes received from                               authentication server.

status.description: Client L2 on-going status 'successful' : L2 on-going successful. 'in_progress': authentication is in progress. 'partial'    : authentication not successful in intended role. 'auth_failed': authentication failed.

l2_latency.description: Authentication related latencies and L2-onboarding timestamp for the client.

auth_latency.description: Time (in microseconds) taken by client to complete authentication. This  is not applicable for non-secure clients.

dot1x_radius_latency.description: Time (in microseconds) taken by 802.1X to complete RADIUS authentication.

l2_onboard_time.description: Time (in microseconds) since Epoch, when L2 on-boarding completed.

macauth_radius_latency.description: Time (in microseconds) taken by MACauth to complete RADIUS authentication.

applied_role_type.description: Type of role applied for the client:  `preauth`:         applied for clients that are yet to be                     authenticated.  `auth`:            applied for clients that have been                     authenticated but have not received any                     specific role or attribute from the                     authentication server.  `reject`:          applied for clients that failed                     authentication.  `critical`:        applied for clients that failed                     authentication due to unreachable.                     authentication servers.  `fallback`:        applied for clients that failed                     to onboard, and no role is derived.  `radius-assigned`: applied for clients that have been                     authenticated and received specific role or                     attribute from the authentication server.  `cached-critical`: applied for clients that failed                     authentication due to unreachable                     authentication servers. This role is                     the previously assigned role for the client                     as provided by the server post authentication.  `critical-voice`:  applied to 'voice' clients that failed                      re-authentication due to server                      unreachability   `ubt-fallback`:    applied for clients on an UBT role that failed                      due to UBT zone unreachability.

authenticating_radius_server.description: RADIUS server that authenticated the client.

error.description: Client authentication failure reasons. Applicable when the status is  'auth_failed'. 'server-reject':       authentication server rejected client request. 'server-timeout':      no response from the authentication server. 'supplicant-timeout':  dot1x client timed out. 'no-server':           no authentication servers configured 'attribute-processing-error': error processing attributes received from                                authentication server.

status.description: Client L2 on-boarding status 'successful' : L2 on-boarding successful. 'in_progress': authentication is in progress. 'partial'    : authentication not successful in intended role. 'auth_failed': authentication failed.

reason_code.description: Client's L3 on-boarding failure reason 'dhcp-failure':     Client DHCP exchange failed. 'no-dhcp': Client did not trigger DHCP.

status.description: Client L3 on-boarding status 'successful' : successful. 'in_progress': in-progress. 'failed'     : failed. 'timeout'    : timeout. 'partial'    : incomplete onboarding.

l4_onboarding_status.description: L4 onboarding related info of the client.

status.description: Client L4 on-boarding status 'successful' : successful. 'failed'     : failed. 'timeout'    : timeout.

mac.description:
Reference Resource: [Client_Insight](#/Client_Insight)
MAC address of the client.

failure_reason.description: Client authentication failure reason 'l2_onboarding_failed'  : L2 onboarding failed. 'l3_onboarding_failed'  : L3 onboarding failed. 'l4_onboarding_failed'  : L4 onboarding failed.

status.description: The client's overall on-boarding status 'successful' : successful. 'failed'     : failed. 'timeout'    : timeout. 'partial'    : incomplete onboarding.

per_vlan_client_insight.description:
Reference Resource: [Client_Insight_Per_VLAN](#/Client_Insight_Per_VLAN)
Per VLAN client insight information for this MAC.
